subject: Capacity uplift request — regional fallback & rate alignment
messages:
From: Ethan Liu <ethan@brightcart.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ops Team <ops@brightcart.com>
Date: Tue, 28 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity uplift request — May commit increase

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're seeing faster-than-expected adoption for the personalization endpoint and need to move up our monthly hosted commit from 400M tokens to 1B tokens starting July 1. High-level asks:
- Confirm achievable p95 latency targets at the 1B commit level for text-generation (default model).
- Clear regional fallback plan if us-west capacity is constrained (we need EU fallback option and cost delta).
- Updated rate limits per-route during onboarding so our burst traffic doesn't trip hard throttles.

Attached is a short request doc with usage graphs and a proposed 12-month term. Can you loop in ops/finance and let me know a timeline for PO + SOW?

Ethan Liu
Director of Engineering, BrightCart
ethan@brightcart.com | 415-555-0192

Attachments: BrightCart_commit_request_v1.pdf (PDF, 220KB)
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Liu <ethan@brightcart.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 28 May 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity uplift request — May commit increase

Hi Ethan — thanks for the doc and congrats on the adoption. Quick update from our side:

1) Performance: at a 1B monthly commit we still meet p95 latency targets for the default gen model in our us-west pool (p95 ~ 210ms for 128-token responses) with recommended batching config. We'll include a token-level cost projection in the SOW.

2) Regional fallback: we can qualify EU as an automatic fallback region. SLA will note a latency delta and a small per-token surcharge when requests are routed cross-region. Karthik — can you confirm the surcharge estimate (ballpark) for EU fallback?

3) Rate limits: we can provision per-route burst windows during onboarding and then transition to steady-state rate bands. Vanessa — ops will own the burst window schedule and the safe throttle thresholds.

Timeline: if we get a signed PO by 6/10 we can have the uplift staged and live by 7/1 with a short canary for the first 72 hours. I attached an internal SOW template to the thread (SOW_draft_BrightCart.docx) and will pull finance into a pricing note after Karthik confirms the EU surcharge.

Next steps: Karthik, Vanessa — please reply with pricing + ops cadence. Ethan — any constraints from Legal on the term language?

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwoodinference.com | +1 617-555-0124

Attachments: SOW_draft_BrightCart.docx (DOCX, 85KB)
From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 29 May 2029 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity uplift request — pricing and routing notes

Camila — notes below (high level):

EU fallback surcharge: +0.8 cents per 1k tokens above standard US hosted rate when routed to eu-central due to cross-region egress and capacity arbitration. This is our ballpark; finance will confirm in the pricing note.

Canary & rollout: staged canary for 72 hours at 10% of traffic, then 50% for 24 hours, then full switch. We'll keep an automatic fallback to US secondary pool if eu-central hits 80% utilization.

Rate limits: propose temporary onboarding burst: 4x steady-rate for first 14 days, with a soft throttle threshold at 6x that triggers a notice to Ops (not hard block). After 30 days, move to agreed steady-state limits in the SOW.

Operational items for handoff:
- Vanessa: schedule a 45-minute onboarding call with BrightCart Ops next week to review routing rules and KV-cache warming.
- Marissa: finance to draft a pricing note and updated invoice cadence (monthly prepay with a 30-day PO schedule).

Marissa — can you prep a short pricing note with the surcharge + the monthly commit uplift numbers? We should also include a pro-rated billing approach for July given the 7/1 start.

Karthik
Director, Serving Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Liu <ethan@brightcart.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, contracts@brightcart.com
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity uplift request — confirmation & next steps

Ethan — quick summary and next steps so we have everything on the same page: 

Summary of agreement (provisional):
- Monthly hosted commit: increase from 400M -> 1B tokens starting 2029-07-01.
- Term: 12 months (auto-renew unless cancelled with 60 days notice).
- EU fallback: enabled; estimated surcharge +0.8 cents /1k tokens when routed to eu-central. Finalized in pricing note.
- Rate limits: onboarding burst 4x steady-rate for 14 days; soft throttle at 6x triggers Ops alert; steady-state limits applied after 30 days.
- Canary: staged rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with 72h initial canary monitoring window.

Attachments and action items: 
- Attached: SOW_draft_BrightCart.docx (internal draft).
- Marissa will send formal pricing note + invoice cadence by EOD tomorrow.
- Legal (BrightCart) — we've cc'd contracts@brightcart.com; if you can send any term redlines by 6/7 we'll incorporate and return a DocuSign link for signature.
- Ops onboarding: Vanessa to schedule a 45-minute kickoff (suggest Tue 6/4 or Wed 6/5).

Ethan — if that reads correctly, I'll have Marissa follow with the pricing note and then share the DocuSign envelope once Legal confirms no major redlines.

Thanks everyone — excited to get BrightCart scaled.

Camila Reyes
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwoodinference.com | +1 617-555-0124
